name: Barbecue Pork Spare Ribs (Grease & Char WARNING)
whyItWorks: Pork spare ribs feature high intermuscular fat, tough chewy gristle, and a sugary, charred barbecue bark loaded with black pepper and chili powder. High fat + tough gristle + spice creates intense digestive cramping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID during active inflammation. Choose lean pork tenderloin medallions instead.
